description:
Read in full against the code at 52ad3bf47 (after fz-gl6.10). These passages state things the code does not do. Re-verify each against the tree at build time, since fz-gl6.7, .8, .11 and .4 rewrite neighbouring text.

guides/memory.html:
- Section 2 says 'The low 4 bits of the pointer identify the heap kind'. The kind rides in the high bits of the ref (AnyValueRefPacking); the low nibble belongs only to the forwarding marker.
- Map layout lists 'count: u64' at offset 0. The header is count << 4 (map_header_word). The unpublished destination header (map_destination_header_word: bit 63, filled << 33, capacity << 4, 29-bit fields) is undocumented.
- 'Other heap layouts' gives Struct and Closure as 'schema_id: u32, flags: u32' and Bitstring as 'bit_len: u64'. Real headers: struct_header_word = schema_id << 32; closure_header_word = (denotation << 32) | (arity << 20) | (flags << 4), arity < CLOSURE_ARITY_LIMIT (4096); bitstring_header_word = bit_len << 4. The per-kind table repeats 'schema_id+flags prefix'.
- Bitstring size is given as align16(8 + ceil(bits/8)). bitstring_size_for_bit_len adds one trailing zero byte.
- ProcBin is called a '16-byte' stub (allocation policy paragraph and the shared-zone diagram, which also omits byte_offset). PROCBIN_BYTES is 32: shared_ptr, mso_next, byte_offset, 8 unused.
- The Resource row says 'shared ptr'; the field is the resource pointer.
- The MSO sweep says the marker is written into 'the first word of every copied object'. List cells take it in word 1; the sweep sees only ProcBin/Resource stubs, whose marker word is word 0.
- Section 12 says 'The watermark already exists.' No watermark exists in the runtime.
- Table of contents entries 3 ('Watermark and back-edge yield') and 4 ('Cheney with one root') do not match their section headings.

.agent/docs/any-value.md:
- Paths src/ir_codegen/{value,repr,closure,fn_ctx}.rs are src/compiler2/native_codegen/*.
- 'ArgRepr::from_ty picks the lane' names a function that does not exist; compiler2 picks AbiValueRepr and codegen copies it with arg_repr_from_compiler2.
- History in place of fact: 'Four callers used to re-derive it ... (fz-5xp.45)', 'Before this, scanning n bytes copied ...', '(fz-5xp.60)'.

Code comments:
- src/compiler2/native_codegen/repr.rs ArgRepr doc: 'Heap pointers preserve their strict low-4 object tag' and 'raw payload plus side-band kind'. ValueRef is one AnyValueRef word.
- runtime/src/any_value.rs raw_alloc doc: 'real GC-managed allocator lands in .11.2' and 'so low-bit pointer tags are available'.

A replacement script drafted on 2026-11-09 applied cleanly to copies of those four files: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/d1d265b3-f8e7-419b-8316-906f89c17e6b/scratchpad/gl6/docfix/apply.py (usage: python3 -I apply.py <worktree root>). It may be gone; the list above is the spec.

Done when: every item above states present fact, verified against the code, and a grep of guides, .agent and README.md for 'low 4 bits of the pointer', 'schema_id: u32, flags', '16-byte <strong>ProcBin', 'watermark already exists', 'src/ir_codegen/', 'from_ty' returns nothing. Done when also: comments are plain present-tense facts with no ticket numbers; full gate green (cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1; cargo test --workspace --doc); no pin or golden moves; commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: The memory guide and value docs describe the heap layout that exists
